## MicroPoroChemoMechanics

![](images/logo_org.png){.jfb-page-logo}

**[MicroPoroChemoMechanics](software/mpcm.qmd)** is a GitHub organization of which I am one of
the owners. It gathers a Julia ecosystem for the coupled micro-chemo-mechanics of porous
reactive media, from molecular-level thermodynamic equilibrium up to the macroscopic
poromechanical response. The three packages below are its core; two further backend packages
(OptimaSolver.jl and DECUHR.jl) are described on the
[organisation page](software/mpcm.qmd).
